@graph.name: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B
ai_typeOfModel: Decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (3:1 ratio)
@graph.ai_informationAboutApplication:
Intended uses: Should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources of information; users should verify important information. The model is an instruct model optimized for hybrid reasoning.
Out of scope: The model should be used as an assistive tool rather than a definitive source of information; users should verify important information.
Target systems: Can be used in agentic systems with tool calling (xml_tools or python_tools), as an instruct/hybrid reasoning model, and deployed via vLLM and SGLang as an OpenAI-compatible API; should be used as an assistive tool.
@graph.ai_limitation: Generated content may not always be factually accurate, logically consistent, or free from biases present in the training data; should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources, and users should verify important information.

ai_metric.value: SmolLM3-3B (no extended thinking): AIME 2025 9.3, GSM-Plus 72.8, LiveCodeBench v4 15.2, GPQA Diamond 35.7, IFEval 76.7, MixEval Hard 26.9, BFCL 92.3, Global MMLU 53.5. Extended thinking: AIME 2025 36.7, GSM-Plus 83.4, LiveCodeBench v4 30.0, GPQA Diamond 41.7, IFEval 71.2, MixEval Hard 30.8, BFCL 88.8, Global MMLU 64.1. All evaluations zero-shot unless stated otherwise, run with lighteval.

ai_standardCompliance: EU AI Act: the card provides a Public Summary of Training Content for GPAI models, following the EU template

externalRef.comment: Distribution channels: Open weights on Hugging Face (model, checkpoints, quantized checkpoints collection); can be deployed via vLLM and SGLang in an OpenAI-compatible API; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch.

@graph.ai_informationAboutTraining:
Pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data; post-training included midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens, followed by supervised fine-tuning and alignment via Anchored Preference Optimization (APO).
training_hardware: 384 H100 GPUs
@graph.comment:
releaseTime: release date not stated in the card; Hugging Face repo creation time used.
access_conditions: false
additional_assets: Pretraining datasets are available in a Hugging Face collection (mid-training and post-training datasets to be uploaded later); training and evaluation configs and code are in the huggingface/smollm GitHub repository; intermediate checkpoints (including mid-training and SFT checkpoints) are at HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-checkpoints; quantized checkpoints are in a Hugging Face collection.
architecture_details: Decoder-only transformer using GQA and NoPE (with 3:1 ratio); 3B parameters. The card gives no layer count, experts or active parameters, and no stated rationale beyond the design aim of pushing the boundaries of small models.
integration_means: Load with transformers (v4.53.0+) via AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer and tokenizer.apply_chat_template; /think and /no_think system prompt flags or enable_thinking kwarg; tool calling via xml_tools or python_tools; serve with vLLM and SGLang in an OpenAI-compatible API; local inference with llama.cpp, ONNX, MLX, MLC and ExecuTorch.
eval_methodology: Evaluations run with lighteval; all zero-shot unless stated otherwise (e.g., MATH 4-shot, GSM8k 5-shot, Flores-200 5-shot). For Ruler 64k, YaRN applied to Qwen models with 32k context to extrapolate context length.
base_model_relation: finetune

data_scope: Pretrained on 11.2T tokens with a staged curriculum of web, code, math and reasoning data; midtraining on 140B reasoning tokens. Trained on English, French, Spanish, German, Italian and Portuguese as main languages, plus fewer tokens of Arabic (standard), Chinese and Russian data.
